items.title: Nestle India extends rally on stellar June quarter, higher costs may limit upside
items.description: Nestle India shares reached a record high after a strong June quarter performance.  Revenue growth accelerated significantly year-on-year, reaching 25.2 percent.  However, operating margins moderated sequentially due to increased advertising investments.  Exports also showed steady growth, driven by market penetration and product additions.  The company anticipates continued healthy demand supported by premiumization and innovation.

items.title: Cipla Q1 Results: Cons profit drops 39% YoY to Rs 789 crore; revenue rises marginally
items.description: Cipla Q1 Results: Pharma major Cipla reported a 39% year-on-year decline in Q1FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 789 crore, mainly due to a high base, while revenue from operations rose a modest 2.3% to Rs 7,119 crore. The company's EBITDA also declined, with margins contracting sharply compared with the year-ago quarter.

items.title: Global Earnings | Hyundai Motor reports 21% drop in Q2 profit, misses forecasts
items.description: Hyundai Motor reported a significant profit drop in the second quarter. Weaker vehicle sales and production disruptions impacted the company's earnings. Higher costs and a competitive market also presented challenges for Hyundai. The automaker is investing in robotics and software-defined vehicles for future growth. Hyundai shares saw a slight increase following the earnings announcement.

items.title: PVR Inox Q1 Results: Co swings to black, posts Rs 56 crore profit vs year-ago loss
items.description: PVR INOX reported a strong June quarter with a net profit of Rs 56.5 crore. Revenue from operations increased to Rs 1,622.2 crore, showing significant year-on-year growth. Admissions rose eight percent while average ticket prices also saw an increase. The company achieved net cash positive status after debt reduction and merger completion. PVR INOX anticipates a robust content pipeline for the remainder of FY27.

items.title: Infosys Q1 Results: Profit rises 12% YoY to Rs 7,769 crore; co trims upper-end revenue forecast
items.description: Infosys Q1 Results: IT services major Infosys reported 12% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 7,769 crore in the first quarter of FY27. The same stood at Rs 6,921 crore in the last year quarter. Revenue from operations in the reporting period increased 14% YoY to Rs 48,211 crore.

items.title: IndiGo Q1 Results: Airline reports Rs 238 crore loss vs profit YoY; revenue rises 20%
items.description: Interglobe Aviation Q1 Results: IndiGo reported a net loss of Rs 238 crore in Q1FY27, compared with a profit of Rs 2,176 crore a year ago, as sharply higher operating costs outweighed strong revenue growth. Revenue from operations rose 20% year on year to Rs 24,584 crore, while total expenses surged 34%, driven largely by higher fuel and operating costs.

items.title: D P Abhushan posts 77% rise in Q1 PAT to Rs 64 crore
items.description: The company posted a PAT of Rs 36.42 crore in Q1 FY26, D P Abhushan said in a statement. Total income for the quarter rose 58% to Rs 854 crore from Rs 541 crore in the June quarter of the financial year ended March 31, 2026, the company said.

items.title: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Q1 profit rises 67% YoY to Rs 86 crore
items.description: Mahindra Lifespace Developers has achieved a remarkable 67 percent increase in net profit for the June quarter, with total income skyrocketing to Rs 977.54 crore from just Rs 40.61 crore last year. items.title: Motilal Oswal Q1 Results: Net profit rises 10% YoY to Rs 1,273 crore; revenue climbs 25%
items.description: Motilal Oswal Financial Services posted a 10% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 1,273 crore, driven by robust growth in its asset management and wealth businesses. Revenue climbed 25%, while AUM crossed Rs 2.12 lakh crore, reflecting strong momentum across its diversified financial services franchise.

items.title: Meesho Q1 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 133 crore; marketplace revenue rises 48%
items.description: Meesho narrowed its June-quarter loss to Rs 133 crore as marketplace revenue surged 48% and user engagement strengthened. Better delivery conversion, higher monetisation, AI-led productivity gains and rapid seller growth, especially from smaller cities, supported improved operating performance.
